description: This file defines an abstract class `TransactionConcurrencyTestRunner` in the namespace `Orleans.Transactions.TestKit`. The class provides methods to run various transaction concurrency tests, such as shared grain sharing, transaction chains, and transaction trees, using Orleans grains and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: TransactionConcurrencyTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract base class providing transaction concurrency testing methods for Orleans grains, including shared grain tests, transaction chains, and transaction trees.

methods.name: SingleSharedGrainTest
methods.description: Performs a test where two transactions share a single grain, verifying the expected state after concurrent add operations.

methods.name: TransactionChainTest
methods.description: Performs a chain of dependent transactions across multiple grains, verifying accumulated values.

methods.name: TransactionTreeTest
methods.description: Performs a test where multiple grains participate in a transaction tree structure, verifying the correct propagation of transaction results.
